svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print in black PETG, top face on the bed, 0.1 mm layers, 100 % infill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Disc 36 mm across, 7.2 mm tall, with three lugs for the shroud screws

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on a 40 mm circle; press an M3 insert into each lug from below.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Eight LED pockets 5.6 mm on a 20 mm circle, each tilted 23 degrees

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inward so the beams meet on the item; leads come out of the top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre bore 5.6 mm for the photodiode can, with a step 4 mm up the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: body; below the step a 4 mm aperture and a baffle tube 7 mm across

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: that stands 0.5 mm proud of the underside and rests on the window.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 3.5 mm holes 12 mm each side for M2.5 inserts (amplifier board).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ream the LED pockets and the bore with a 5.6 mm drill by hand.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each LED can slides in and stops square; the bore is black inside.
